_format_note: Consumers MUST check format_version and refuse an unexpected value. v1 free-text scope; v2 machine-readable applies_to; v3 applies_to.radio widened to a list; v4 ADDS an optional radial (amplitude) profile alongside the phase one. A v3 consumer that ignores unknown keys is unaffected -- radial_* keys are additive and the phase keys are byte-identical. applies_to.radio may be str OR list-of-str.

applies_to.note: User decision, revised 2026-09-08: applies to THE FOUR RADIOS THE SHAPE WAS MEASURED ON, at 89_2400 ONLY. Not a generalisation -- all four were measured directly (per-radio correlation with S 0.9995-0.9997, A = 3.885/3.645/3.729/3.879 deg). The CONFIG restriction stands unchanged: do NOT scale this shape to 433/915. That would be the untestable generalisation, and it would flatten the carrier-frequency and gain structure these datasets exist to carry. Other configs keep their fitted cubic, preamble extrapolation defect included, as a documented limitation. Radios outside this list have no measured amplitude here.

measured_on.note: shape was measured across 4 radios (corr with S 0.9995-0.9997) but is APPROVED for use only on the pair in applies_to

convention.zero: mean-removed over the DATA portion (t>=0.0769); a constant offset is absorbed by the per-burst carrier-phase alignment
convention.delay: measured on the delay-CORRECTED burst average (fit_residual_delay then add_bulk_delay(-tau)); consumer must NOT re-apply a delay correction
convention.interp: linear between points; hold end values constant outside [0.0035, 0.8265]
convention.null_tail: hold the last value for t>0.846 (no signal there, so unobservable; holding avoids a discontinuity)
convention.estimator: tap-referenced, whole-span aligned; validated against injected ground truth at 1.10/1.11/0.99x and corr 0.864/0.958/0.994 at 433/915/2400
convention.config: DESCRIPTIVE FREE TEXT -- do not parse. Use applies_to.config for matching.

radial_convention: percent deviation of the common-gain MAGNITUDE about its burst mean; apply as multiply by (1 + 0.01*radial_pct). Same t grid, same delay-corrected basis, same blocks as the phase shape. Constant gain is absorbed by the tap fit, so this is deviation only. MEASURED: |mean|/sd 3.5-6.4 across 4 runs, run-to-run shape correlation 0.917-0.970, cross-radio 0.926 -- real and common-mode, but SMALL (0.135-0.312 %% rms).
